svg.text: Figure 3. Completion versus harm on the locked txn_test (440 tasks)
Upper left is better. Large marks pool the seeds; whiskers are Wilson 95% intervals; small open marks are single seeds. The middle panel enlarges the dashed corner of the left panel.

svg.text: Source: results/txn/*__txn_test.summary.json and results/sel1/*__txn_test.summary.json (block 'all'). Denominators: 440 episodes per scripted policy; 1,320 per model seed (440 tasks x 1 greedy + 2 sampled). Intervals treat episodes as independent; a task's
three episodes and the three seeds are correlated, so model intervals are too narrow. B4 and A1-A6 are scripted with the fault taxonomy written in; they are references, not learned agents.
